decisive_items: Long exercise test: 25% maximal decrement at 45 minutes post-exercise
High-arched palate, elongated face with dolichocephaly
Muscle biopsy: whorled fibers, scattered lipid droplets
response.rationale: R4 is supported by characteristic facial features, long exercise test decrement, and muscle biopsy findings, despite the absence of myotonia on EMG. R1 is less likely due to normal reflexes and lack of facial features. R2 is unlikely due to neurogenic EMG findings.

rejected.why: Neurogenic EMG findings (giant motor unit potentials) and normal acid alpha-glucosidase activity contradict congenital muscular dystrophy.
Normal deep tendon reflexes and lack of characteristic facial features make spinal muscular atrophy less likely.
